title: Flat vector
description: Clean geometric shapes with solid fills and crisp edges, as drawn in vector software.

art_style.outline_policy: No outline, or one uniform stroke width across the whole set.
art_style.shading_policy: Solid fills with at most one flat shadow shape; a very subtle gradient is optional.

native_size_guidance: Draw at about twice the final display size and reduce once with a smooth filter; keep every asset in a set at the same scale.
avoid: Do not use textures, noise or brush effects.
Do not vary stroke width between assets.
Do not add detail that is not a clean shape.
